title: After the Takarazuka Kinen: Watch Out World!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Wow, what a great race! McQueen ran so well.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: And how about Matikanetannhauser? I feel like she's got, like… a whole different energy about her than in her classic year.

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Reporter
text_block_list.text: …As always, she's got her eye on the prize and is still getting better.

text_block_list.name: Bespectacled Reporter
text_block_list.text: I have to do my best too!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I'm baaack!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Heh. Thank you! But I still think I've got a long way to go.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: There's still so much I can do to improve. I need to start training for the next race!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: So… about my next race… I wanna run in the Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: There aren't many races in Japan where you can face Umamusume from all around the world! Talk about a supercharged race!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: O-obviously, I'm not confident I can win or anything, but…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Still, I wanna give it a shot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hearing that, I immediately agree to set our sights on the Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Tannhauser! Thank you for giving me such a good race today.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh, hey McQueen! You were so cool out there!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: We both ran in the spring Tenno Sho, but you have improved so much since then.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Really?! You think so?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes. We haven't raced together very often, but I can tell.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: You are many times better than what I've seen of you at the academy and in other races.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: That was… painfully evident in today's race.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Really? Ehehe. Thank you for saying so.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I can tell how hard you've been working too, you know!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Watching you run and seeing how much you shine gave me the courage I needed to win today!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: …Is that right? Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: We may find ourselves competing again sometime in the future.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I look forward to when that day comes.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Same here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our next goal race is the Japan Cup. We need to keep pushing forward and get even better!
